SS-WIDGET-LIBRARY.Purpose: Concrete declarative UI widgets and shared native IMGUI appearance services: layout containers, display surfaces and controlled input controls.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: View, ScrollView and CanvasView: visual container, native scrolling, viewport pan and zoom.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Label and Image: intrinsic content measurement and rendering, with optional own-image corner radii on Image.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Button and controlled Checkbox, TextField, HorizontalSlider and AreaSlider.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Widgets/Drawers/: shared background, border, shadow and image operations with their drawing parameters, geometry helpers and masks.
Scope.SCP-IN-005: GradientTextures: texture factory providing linear, radial and conic gradients.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Base Widget runtime, geometry, clipping and dispatch — owned by SS-WIDGET-RUNTIME.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Offscreen group composition and replacement graphics backends.

Principles.PRIN-001: General background images/colors, painted borders and outer shadows belong to View. Label, Button, TextField and Image compose with View instead of repeating its surface Props.
Principles.PRIN-002: Native controls remain native when required for editing and RimWorld interaction; wrapping is not a requirement to replace every Verse.Widgets call.
Principles.PRIN-003: Controlled value and checked Props are owner-authoritative; user gestures propose changes via OnValueChange.
Principles.PRIN-004: Appearance properties are flat Props, not nested Style objects; shared drawers are implementation helpers, not widget superclasses.

Requirements.REQ-001: All library widgets participate in the common Widget layout, input, render and lifecycle hooks.
Requirements.REQ-002: Disabled controls do not emit value changes, submit/cancel or button actions; native focus/editing is retained for enabled text controls.
Requirements.REQ-003: View uses the shared appearance drawers for decoration; Image uses ImageDrawer only for its own texture. Button and TextField can suppress their stock native backgrounds when composed inside View.
